channel.title: Dan Patrick Show (Filtered)
channel.description: Daily DP Show episodes without C&R or Best Of clips.
channel.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Seahawks Sold, Best and Worst
item.description:
DP and the Danettes discuss the recent sale of the defending Super Bowl champion Seattle Seahawks for nearly $10B. And the guys share their thoughts on the best and worst action over the weekend.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – LeBron’s Hollywood Ending, Lake Tahoe Recap
item.description:
Dan speculates on LeBron’s latest free agency decision and wonders if anybody really cares, besides LeBron, where he plays his final season. And DP and the Danettes recap an eventful broadcast from Lake Tahoe last week where Seahawks HC Mike Macdonald set the Boston media off and the WNBA Commissioner snubbed the show after agreeing to appear.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Setting the Record Straight, Conor McGregor Injured
item.description:
DP sets the record straight after Boston media ran rampant speculation about comments that Seattle Seahawks HC Mike Macdonald made on the show from Lake Tahoe last week. And Conor McGregor’s return to the Octagon was a dismal failure as the fight ended due to a knee injury at just 1:09 of the first round.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Let Him In, Ben Horney
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes consider the changing opinions on Barry Bonds as time takes us further and further away from his accomplishments as well as the allegations of PED use. And sports finance insider Ben Horney drops by with the details on the sale of the Seattle Seahawks.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Best Comedian of All Time, Jeremy Fowler
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes get completely absorbed by a discussion about the great comedian of all time and they take some calls about it. Plus, NFL insider Jeremy Fowler drops by to discuss his latest NFL QB rankings.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – HR Derby Sets the Example, NFL QB Rankings
item.description:
Dan enjoyed watching the HR Derby once he was able to find it on Netflix, and he thinks the NBA could learn something from how MLB handled the event. Plus, Dan and the Danettes consider the rising and falling stocks of this current crop of “elite” QBs in the NFL.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Tony Reali, WNBA Commissioner Cathy Engelbert Under Fire
item.description:
Longtiem friend of the program, Tony Reali stops by to chop it up with DP and the Danettes as he graciously offers to fill in the next time DP head on vacation. Plus, DP share more about the latest rumors plaguing WNBA Commissioner Cathy Engelbert, what he knew, and when he knew it.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Awkward Legacy Question, Eric Wynalda
item.description:
Rory McIlroy was pressed to answer an awkward question about his legacy. DP breaks down what was wrong with the question and the Danettes consider their own legacies. And former USMNT standout Eric Wynalda stops by to talk World Cup and tells DP that not only does he have the solution for American soccer, but he’s also already begun implementing it.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – MLB All-Star Game, John Smoltz
item.description:
Dan thoroughly enjoyed last night’s MLB All-Star Game despite the lack of offense, and he thinks the AL pitching staff should’ve been awarded the MVP. And Hall of Fame P and current analyst, John Smoltz drops by to give his impressions of the Midsummer Classic and this season of baseball at the halfway point.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Mike Tirico, Jason Garrett
item.description:
Legendary broadcaster Mike Tirico describes the scene from the Open Championship and discusses Scottie Scheffler's recent form. Former Cowboys HC Jason Garrett discusses his new coaching podcast series, explaining what separates great coaches from one another. 

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Scalping Tickets to The Oddyssey, Stu Holden
item.description:
DP and the Danettes discuss scalping tickets for The Oddyssey. Fox Soccer analyst Stu Holden joins the show to recap England vs. Argentina Sem-Final and the legacy of Messi.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – ESPY Errors, Messi Magic
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes lambast last night’s ESPY Awards, specifically for their choice for “Team of the Year.” And nobody is surprised to see Lionel Messi and Argentina produce another late game comeback to advance to the World Cup Final.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – The LeBron Game, Will Ferrell
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes play “The LeBron Game” where they try to determine where LeBron James will play next season. And comedian/actor Will Ferrell stops by the studio to promote his newest Netflix comedy series, “The Hawk.”

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Golden Boot Odds, Darius Rucker
item.description:
DP weighs in on the race for the World Cup’s Golden Boot after finding out any goals in the consolation game are included in the calculation. And country music star Darius Rucker drops by to sing his latest single and Rick Roll Fritzy with a duet.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Pressure on LeBron to Make a Decision, More Caitlin Clark Controversy
item.description:
NBA Commissioner Adam Silver is putting pressure on LeBron to make a decision so they can finalize the NBA schedule for next season. Plus, DP and the Danettes consider the latest incident in a long list of missteps from the WNBA and Caitlin Clark.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Ryan Fox Wins The Open Championship, Mike Florio
item.description:
Dan picks Ryan Fox’s win at The Open Championship yesterday as the biggest story in golf this year. And NFL insider Mike Florio stops by to talk some pigskin as we approach the beginning of the NFL preseason.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Hollywood “No,” Rebecca Lowe
item.description:
Dan loves getting roles in Adam Sandler movies and talks about pursuing bit parts in Hollywood and how often he gets turned down. Plus, FOX World Cup anchor Rebecca Lowe drops by to recap what may go down as the greatest World Cup ever.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Wild World Cup, Betting on Tears
item.description:
Dan recaps a fantastic World Cup and the Danettes try to determine the greatest defensive sports team of all time after Spain allowed only one goal for the entire tournament. And Dan is getting ready for his daughter’s wedding and the Danettes are setting odds on who when the crying will begin during Dan’s speech.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 - Waiting on LeBron, Running Back Greatness Factors
item.description:
Dan explains why it isn't the worst thing that we're all waiting on LeBron James to make a decision & how he's earned that right, then him and Danettes debate all the factors that makes a running back "great." 

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 - Nick Pappas, Taco Bell Lettuce
item.description:
Dan is joined by NFL Director Nick Pappas to discuss the ongoing conversation about the turf vs. natural grass in NFL stadiums. Dan and the Danettes talk about the lettuce issues plaguing the country & debate how sometimes it is appropriate to eat Taco Bell,

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 - Drew Brees, Andrew Brandt
item.description:
Dan is joined by NFL Hall of Famer & NFL game analyst Drew Brees to talk about NFL stadiums inserting real grass for the World Cup but having artificial turf for NFL games. Dan is then joined by author and former Packers Vice President Andrew Brandt to discuss the state of NIL in college athletics.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1- Where will LeBron go + The Odessey REVIEW
item.description:
Dan Patrick talks Lebron James and where he possibly might go in the NBA, Dan and the danettes reviews The Odessey and talks Christopher Nolan .

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2- SEC Drama + Vincent Goodwill Jr.
item.description:
Dan shares his opinion on SEC and its decision to possibly separate itself from college football. ESPN NBA Senior Writer Vincent Goodwill Jr. joins the show.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Caitlin Clark not in the 3 Point Contest, Have you read Homer?
item.description:
Caitlin Clark and Sabrina Ionescu will not be in the WNBA’s 3-point contest, with conflicting reports on whether or not they were invited in the first place. Dan can’t understand it, why wouldn’t you be asking for your biggest names and a two-time defending champ in Ionescu? Dan talks about the Odyssey and why Homer doesn’t have a last name (or a first?)

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2- Dan talks ESPN layoffs, Matt Damon
item.description:
Dan gets asked about the layoffs hitting the Mothership, and talks about his belief in letting someone go with dignity rather than haphazardly as ESPN is doing. Hollywood superstar Matt Damon joins Dan to talk about filming the Odyssey, getting cut for the role and trying not to get hurt; plus working with Christopher Nolan, how the movie was carried by Samantha Morton and reveals how much he’s bench pressing.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3- Chris Simms defends putting Tom Brady #9 all time, Heather Dinich talks Lane Kiffin
item.description:
Pro football analyst Chris Simms joins Dan to talk about his all-time quarterback rankings, why he puts Peyton Manning first and he spars with Dan over his placement of Tom Brady and explains why he doesn’t think he was ever the best quarterback in the league in any single year. ESPN college football insider Heather Dinich discusses LSU head coach Lane Kiffin as he enters the crosshairs of other SEC coaches. 

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: 7/22 Hour 3- NFL training camp headlines , Matt Damon dramatic change for movie roles
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes predict what might be in the headlines with multiple NFL teams opening up for training camp, Dan talks about  upcoming guest , actor Matt Damon and his dramatic weight loss for his newest movie and brings up other actors who went through physical changes for movie roles

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3- LeBron signs with the 76ers, should Dan do another hour?
item.description:
A massive Friday news bomb hits as LeBron James is expected to sign with the Philadelphia 76ers, Dan and the Danettes react as east coast basketball is set for a massive resurgence. Can you visualize LeBron in a Sixers jersey?

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 - Incident with the Golf Bros, Joey Votto
item.description:
Dan shares a story about where he and the Danettes were accosted for their dress on the country club golf course. What’s even the etiquette for this? Former MLB star Joey Votto is set to join Bob Costas in the NBC broadcast booth and discusses that transition in his life, plus debates with Dan about how steroid era players should be handled and why he doesn’t want someone telling him how he should feel about a player’s legacy.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 - Tyreek Hill a Hall of Famer? Sabrina Ionescu debacle continues
item.description:
Tyreek Hill struggles to get back from injury as he tells the press he has no power in his left leg. Dan and the Danettes discuss his already-storied career. The controversy over Sabrina Ionescu’s exclusion from the WNBA 3-point contest continues as confusion reigns. A very notable exclusion from Chris Simm’s top 10 all-time quarterbacks list is brought up.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
